passage:
Welcome to our library's repair workshop. We once left tools on a shelf for neighbours to share. It was quick, but nobody knew who had taken what. Now you collect tools at the desk: a volunteer checks the tool with you and records your loan. If you have already used the exact model, you may skip the demonstration, but not the check. The model number is on the tool, so don't rely on the name on its case. The workshop leader gives demonstrations for powered tools and won't be at the desk until noon.
After your first loan, you can return tools in our courtyard lockers. Scan your card and wait for the return confirmation. As our librarian says, “A quick exit is fine. A disappearing act isn't.”
The courtyard is open on Sunday, but the desk is closed until Monday. If you find a damaged cable, never use a locker; hand the tool to someone at the desk. When the desk is closed, submit a damage report on our website before the tool is due. That report lets you return it at the next desk opening without a late fee.

questions.prompt: A member comes in at ten for a powered tool. The name on its case is familiar, but the model number is new to the member. What should the member do before taking it home?

choices.A: Wait for the workshop leader's demonstration, and have the tool checked and the loan recorded at the desk.
choices.B: Have it checked and the loan recorded at ten, then skip the demonstration because the case name is familiar.
choices.C: Ask the desk volunteer to demonstrate it at ten and record the loan, without doing a separate check.
choices.D: Wait until noon, use the workshop leader's demonstration as the tool check, and take the tool after recording the loan.

questions.prompt: How does the librarian’s joke relate to the old way of sharing tools?

choices.A: It suggests that lending tools should be quick enough to skip the return confirmation.
choices.B: It warns that the new lockers make it even harder to track tools than the old shelf did.
choices.C: It points out that people can still leave quickly, as long as the loan or return is recorded.
choices.D: It explains why the library no longer lets people return tools without speaking to a volunteer.

questions.prompt: A regular member discovers a damaged cable on Sunday morning. The tool is due at five that afternoon. Which plan avoids a late fee and follows the return procedure?

choices.A: Submit a damage report before five and leave the tool in a courtyard locker on Sunday.
choices.B: Submit a damage report before five and hand the tool to a staff member at the desk on Monday.
choices.C: Hand it to the desk on Monday and submit the damage report at the same time.
choices.D: Tell someone at the courtyard on Sunday, then leave the tool by the closed desk that afternoon.
